description: This file implements serialization utilities including string conversions, hex and base64 encoding/decoding, and Unicode code point handling within the Thunder::Core namespace.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts wide character string to std::string.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts wchar_t array to std::string, considering Unicode support.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts char array to std::string with specified length.

methods.name: ToHexString
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a hexadecimal string with optional delimiter.

methods.name: FromHexString
methods.description: Decodes a hexadecimal string into a byte array.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Encodes a byte vector into a base64 string with optional padding.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string into a byte vector.

methods.name: CodePointToUTF16
methods.description: Converts a Unicode code point to UTF-16 surrogate pair.

methods.name: UTF16ToCodePoint
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 surrogate pair to a Unicode code point.

methods.name: ToCodePoint
methods.description: Decodes a UTF-8 sequence to a Unicode code point.

methods.name: FromCodePoint
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode code point into UTF-8 sequence.

methods.name: ToQuotedString
methods.description: Escapes internal quotes in a string and wraps it with quotes.
